## Q2 FY27 results (quarter ended Sep 2026, announced 17 Oct 2026)
- Standalone net profit +4.7% YoY to ₹19,510 cr; NII +9.7% YoY to ₹34,620 cr, supported by 16.3% growth in gross advances; deposits +18.8%; lower treasury gains and higher expenses capped profit growth (2026-10-17; https://www.business-standard.com/companies/quarterly-results/hdfc-bank-q2fy27-result-net-profit-rises-4-7-to-19-510-cr-nii-up-9-7-126101700465_1.html)
- Q2 FY27 vs Q2 FY26: NII ₹34,620 cr vs ₹31,550 cr; profit ₹19,510 cr vs ₹18,640 cr; profit excluding treasury trading gains grew about 12.6%; ROE 13.5% (2026-10-19; https://www.indmoney.com/blog/stocks/hdfc-bank-q2-results-analysis)
- Q2 FY27 presentation: total deposits ₹33.3 trn (+18.8% YoY, +4.9% QoQ); average deposits ₹31.7 trn; gross advances +16.3% YoY to ₹32.2 trn; AUM +15.3% to ₹33.1 trn; ROA 1.78%, ROE 13.5% (2026-10-17; https://www.investing.com/news/company-news/hdfc-bank-q2-fy27-slides-deposits-surge-19-margins-stabilize-93CH-4955409)
- Gross NPA ratio improved to 1.11%; NIM 3.16% on total assets and 3.32% on interest-earning assets (as reported by Zeebiz/Kotak Neo summaries). Kotak Neo headline cites profit +5.6% (likely consolidated basis) (2026-10-19; https://www.kotakneo.com/news/stocks/hdfc-bank-q2-results-2026-nii-growth-profit-and-asset-quality/)
- Screener table shows quarterly net profit ₹21,537 cr (+5.55% YoY) and sales ₹95,132 cr (+9.35%) for HDFC Bank, apparently consolidated, versus ₹19,510 cr standalone elsewhere (2026-10-29; https://www.screener.in/market/IN05/IN0501/IN050102/)

## Management commentary / guidance
- Per JPMorgan note: reported NIM fell 10bps QoQ to 330bps (FCNR impact). Management gave a neutral-to-positive NIM outlook, helped by a 25bps repo rate hike (about 70% of the book is floating, much of it repo-linked) and a mix shift (2026-10-19; https://www.businesstoday.in/amp/markets/stocks/story/hdfc-bank-q2-review-earnings-in-line-with-estimates-brokerages-share-price-targets-562326-2026-10-19)
- PL Capital: NIM adjusted for FCNR would have been flat-to-positive QoQ; bank says NIM has bottomed and should be supported by rate hike and a shift toward retail/MSME from corporate and home loans. Emkay: NIM down 8bps QoQ to 3.3%, broadly stable in Q3 expected (2026-10-19; https://www.goodreturns.in/news/hdfc-bank-shares-fall-2-3-after-q2-results-jefferies-pl-jm-emkay-see-up-to-44-upside-better-than-fds-1542415.html)
- Nomura: core PPOP ₹28,700 cr (+12% YoY, +3% QoQ); NII +3% QoQ lagged peers (Axis/ICICI 5–6%); FCNR(B) was 3.3% of deposits vs 7–8% at peers; LCR fell to 113% (−2pp QoQ), near the low end of the 110–120% operating band (2026-10-19; https://www.businesstoday.in/amp/markets/stocks/story/hdfc-bank-q2-review-earnings-in-line-with-estimates-brokerages-share-price-targets-562326-2026-10-19)

## News and macro drivers

**Company**
- **Q2 FY27 results (17 Oct 2026):** Mixed, and the effect is neutral to mildly negative.
  - Positives: core PPOP +12%, GNPA 1.11%, strong deposit growth.
  - Negatives: headline profit +4.7%, NII lagging peers, tighter LCR.
  - Materiality: high.
- **NIM guidance (19 Oct 2026):** Positive, medium materiality ([Business Today](https://www.businesstoday.in/amp/markets/stocks/story/hdfc-bank-q2-review-earnings-in-line-with-estimates-brokerages-share-price-targets-562326-2026-10-19); [Goodreturns](https://www.goodreturns.in/news/hdfc-bank-shares-fall-2-3-after-q2-results-jefferies-pl-jm-emkay-see-up-to-44-upside-better-than-fds-1542415.html)).

  - Emkay expects Q3 to be broadly stable.

- The macro research failed entirely. The RBI's policy stance, the date of the latest MPC, liquidity, and the global risk drivers of FII flows are unknown.
- The only data point is management citing a 25bps repo hike as a NIM tailwind. About 70% of the book is floating, much of it repo-linked. This is positive for margins near-term, but the broader effect of a hiking cycle on credit growth and asset quality is unassessed.
